svg.title: Ladybug architecture
svg.desc: One React PWA with a simulator mode, which runs both phones side by side with browser-local state and no account, and a connected mode installed on two phones. Connected writes queue offline, then go through Supabase RPCs, the only write path, into Postgres guarded by row-level security; photos are redrawn in the browser and stored privately. Realtime sends a hint back and Edge Functions deliver push notifications. Shared product rules keep the PWA and the earlier SwiftUI and Firebase app consistent. Self-hosted CI checks migrations, a three-account journey, and WebKit and Chromium runs.
